REPORT=[]
def record(name, **data):
    REPORT.append({'check':name,**data}); print(json.dumps(REPORT[-1],ensure_ascii=False))
def module(revision):
    dest=OUT/revision; dest.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive',revision,SOURCE],cwd=ROOT)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive: archive.extractall(dest,filter='data')
    package=types.ModuleType('shared_compat_'+revision); package.__path__=[str(dest/SOURCE)]; sys.modules[package.__name__]=package
    return importlib.import_module(package.__name__+'.ees_workflow')
def j(value): return json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)
def insert(db,table,values):
    db.execute('INSERT INTO '+table+'('+','.join(values)+') VALUES('+','.join('?' for _ in values)+')',tuple(values.values()))
class SyntheticNativePermission:
    def __init__(self): self.checks=[]
    async def check(self,actor,reference): self.checks.append(copy.deepcopy(reference))

        assert result['ok'],result
        return result
    created=await command(new,'create_workflow',system_id='EMS',name='Synthetic Confluence shared query')
    wid=created['workflow_id']; definition=copy.deepcopy(created['workflow']['draft']); root=next(iter(definition['nodes']))
    definition['nodes'][root]['children']=['t1']
    definition['nodes']['t1']={'id':'t1','type':'t','name':'Synthetic stage','parent':root,'children':['search','page'],'deps':[]}
    for jobid,function,key,value,block in [('search','search_pages','query','Synthetic search text','list_confirm'),('page','get_page','page_id','synthetic-123','human_confirm')]:
        sid='managed-'+function
        definition['nodes'][jobid]={'id':jobid,'type':'j','name':jobid,'parent':'t1','children':[],'deps':[],'mode':'tool','result_block':block,'human_confirmation':True,'shared_tool_id':sid,'inputs':[{'id':key,'name':key,'type':'text','required':True,'scope':'run','source':{'shared_tool_id':sid}}],'argument_bindings':{key:{'input':key}},'shared_tool_generated':{'shared_tool_id':sid,'argument_bindings':{key:{'input':key}},'previous_result_block':'human_confirm','result_block':block}}

    new_state=await new.workspace_state(actor,workflow_id=wid)
    assert new_state['workflow']['draft']==definition
    record('new_service_save_shared_search_and_page',ok=True,revision=saved['revision'])
    # Fixture rows represent already saved query results; no external tool executes.
    runid='synthetic-run'; now='2026-10-22T00:00:00+00:00'; inputs={'query':'Synthetic search text','page_id':'synthetic-123'}
    runvalues=dict(id=runid,workflow_id=wid,version=1,system_id='EMS',factory_id='',owner=actor['id'],sharing=j({'group_ids':[]}),mode='on_demand',status='completed',revision=1,inputs=j(inputs),snapshot=j({'definition':definition,'definition_hash':__import__('hashlib').sha256(j(definition).encode()).hexdigest(),'factory':None,'condition_results':{}}),created_at=now,updated_at=now,closed_at=now)

        insert(db,'work_runs',runvalues)
        for jobid,function in [('search','search_pages'),('page','get_page')]:
            sid='managed-'+function; reference={'tool_id':'synthetic-confluence','function':function,'content_hash':'synthetic-hash'}
            registry={'id':sid,'version':1,'revision':1,'function':function,'reference':reference,'state':'available','group_ids':['synthetic-group']}
            pin={key:registry[key] for key in ('id','version','reference')}
            insert(db,'work_shared_tools',dict(id=sid,revision=1,data=j(registry)))
            insert(db,'work_shared_tool_versions',dict(tool_id=sid,version=1,data=j(registry)))
            insert(db,'work_shared_tool_pins',dict(run_kind='work',run_id=runid,tool_id=sid,data=j(pin)))
            run=db.execute('SELECT * FROM work_runs WHERE id=?',(runid,)).fetchone()
            snapshot=new._work_snapshot(db,run,jobid)
            result={'items':[{'id':'synthetic-123','title':'Synthetic stored search result','url':'https://example.invalid/wiki/synthetic-123'}],'complete':True} if jobid=='search' else {'id':'synthetic-123','title':'Synthetic stored page','body':'Synthetic stored content','url':'https://example.invalid/wiki/synthetic-123'}
            expected_results[jobid]=result

            insert(db,'work_jobs',dict(run_id=runid,job_id=jobid,status='completed',revision=1,current_attempt='attempt-'+jobid,claim_actor=None,reason=''))
    protected=['work_shared_tools','work_shared_tool_versions','work_shared_tool_pins','work_versions','work_runs','work_jobs','work_attempts']

        with service._db() as db: return {table:[dict(row) for row in db.execute('SELECT * FROM '+table+' ORDER BY rowid')] for table in protected}

    assert state['ok'],state

    actual_results={item['job_id']:item['result'] for item in state['run']['attempts']}
    assert actual_results==expected_results,(actual_results,expected_results)
    record('old_service_read_shared_query_and_saved_results',ok=True,full_draft_equal=True,results_equal=True,native_permission_checks=len(bridge.checks),native_permission='synthetic allow; shared registry group/state is not checked by old code')
    edited=copy.deepcopy(state['workflow']['draft']); edited['name']='Synthetic renamed only'
    saved_old=await command(old,'save_draft',2,workflow_id=wid,definition=edited)
    after=rows(old)
    assert before==after
    with old._db() as db: raw=json.loads(db.execute('SELECT draft FROM work_definitions WHERE id=?',(wid,)).fetchone()[0])
    assert raw==edited
    assert raw['nodes']==definition['nodes']
    record('old_service_save_roundtrip_no_silent_deletion',ok=True,full_saved_draft_equal=True,nodes_unchanged=True,protected_tables_unchanged=protected,revision=saved_old['revision'])
    errors,warnings=importlib.import_module(oldmod.__package__+'.ees_workflow_workspace').definition_check(edited)
    assert len(errors)==2 and all('검증된 Native 도구 참조가 필요합니다.' in error for error in errors),errors
    record('old_complete_validation_rejects_shared_only_jobs',errors=errors)
    # Explicitly query-only fake bridge above never implements/executes a tool.

    (OUT/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(REPORT,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
